messages:
Jia: Quick share — ran a small cross-region bench on mosaic-7b (q4f16) comparing A100 vs H100 for 1k/2k seq prefill+decode. Noting weird p95 spikes on A100 in eu-west when seq >1024, looks like kernel fallthrough to slower matmul path. Logs attached.
Mike: Seen that before — L2 eviction on older ampere firmware. What batch/kv config?
Jia: batch=1, kv_cache=enabled, continuous batching off. Commands:
```./bench --model mosaic-7b --gpu a100 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --quant q4f16 --kv on```
Ana: Can you paste tokens/sec and $/1M? rough numbers ok.
Jia: decode-only tokens/sec: A100 eu-west: ~320 t/s @seq1024 -> 210 t/s @seq2048. H100 eu-west: ~420 t/s @seq1024 -> 400 t/s @seq2048. Estimated $/1M tokens: A100 ~ $2.45, H100 ~ $1.95 (spot-ish).
Kevin: That delta suggests kernel selection is bad path. Also saw L2 thrash when kv_cache shards >1. Try disabling shard prefetch.
Dena: Also check cuda/cublas driver — older drivers in eu-west had fallback into TF32 matmul.
ops-bench-bot: trace summary for 3055554321: A100 eu-west kernel fallback at seq>1200 -> use 'gemm_fallback_v2'; H100 stayed on 'fused_attn_v1'.
Mike: Workaround: cap max_prefill_len to 1024 for A100 in eu-west or force kernel_hint fused_attn. Try q8x4 too — quant changes memory footprint.
Jia: Quick q8x4 run: A100 2048 -> ~260 t/s; H100 2048 -> ~360 t/s. Cost estimates: A100 ~$1.95/1M, H100 ~$1.6/1M. Small quality delta on evals (BLEU ~ -0.4).
Ana: Proposal: route seq>1024 traffic in eu-west A100 to H100 pool or apply kernel_hint for that SKU. I'll draft a canary.
Kevin: Add runtime guardrail: detect 'gemm_fallback_v2' and auto-failover to H100 if available. p95 SLA slipping.
Jia: I'll upload perf logs + short runbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:
